say:3:1421815001:1.text: You're safe with us, young lady.
say:3:1421815001:1.source_cn: 小姑娘，我们不会伤害你！

say:4:1421815002:1.text: We're scholars from the Evergreen Conservatory, just here to conduct research.
say:4:1421815002:1.source_cn: 我们是冬青学会的学者，来这里是为了学术研究！

say:5:1421815003:1.text: You won't find better people in this world than us.
say:5:1421815003:1.source_cn: 世界上可再找不出比我、梅丽莎还有这位魔法师<male>...
say:5:1421815003:1.male: You won't find better people in this world than us.
say:5:1421815003:1.female: You won't find better people in this world than us.

say:6:1421815004:1.text: But... you did this to the mushrooms... and my flowers...
say:6:1421815004:1.source_cn: 但是你们伤害了巨蕈……巨蕈现在变成了这样……我种的花也...

say:7:1421815005:1.text: We'll make this right—we swear it in the name of scholars! Our priority now is to figure out the cause of the withering.
say:7:1421815005:1.source_cn: 以学者之名发誓，我们肯定会负起责任的！现在当务之急是搞...

say:8:1421815006:1.text: You really didn't do it on purpose? I heard you mention a quickgrow potion... What did you make it with?
say:8:1421815006:1.source_cn: 你们真的不是故意的吗？我听你们提到了速生魔药……那是用...

choice_prompt:9:1421815006.text: You really didn't do it on purpose? I heard you mention a quickgrow potion... What did you make it with?
choice_prompt:9:1421815006.source_cn: 你们真的不是故意的吗？我听你们提到了速生魔药……那是用什么东西做的？

say:10:1421815007:1.text: Dashroot powder...? Dashroot... is that the name of a plant?
say:10:1421815007:1.source_cn: 疾根草粉末……？疾根草……是一种植物的名字？

say:11:1421815008:1.text: I'm curious about what it looks like! I know all the plants here, but I've never heard of one by that name...
say:11:1421815008:1.source_cn: 我想知道这种植物的样子！因为我很熟悉这里的植物，可我印...

say:12:1421815009:1.text: Hmm, how should I describe it? This is a tough one...
say:12:1421815009:1.source_cn: 疾根草的样子该怎么描述来着，这可有点为难我了……

say:13:1421815010:1.text: Gali, you can show her the book! "The Study of Ancient Biomes"!
say:13:1421815010:1.source_cn: 对了，伽利！让小姑娘看看那本书！《古国生物群落考》！

say:14:1421815011:1.text: There might be a section on dashroot in there.
say:14:1421815011:1.source_cn: 说不定里面有介绍疾根草的部分！

say:15:1421815012:1.text: Let me see... Found it! Page 814—Dashroot. It thrives in warm climates with plenty of water... There's even an illustration next to the text!
say:15:1421815012:1.source_cn: 我来找找……有了！《古国生物群落考》第814页，疾根草...

say:16:1421815013:1.text: So many things in this book are new to me! There are flowers, trees, vines, and mushrooms I've never seen before...
say:16:1421815013:1.source_cn: 这上面有好多我不认识的生物，有花草树木，也有藤蔓蕈菇……

say:17:1421815014:1.text: Is this the dashroot you mentioned? What a peculiar plant...
say:17:1421815014:1.source_cn: 你们说的疾根草长这样吗？真是奇特的植物……

say:18:1421815015:1.text: I'm absolutely sure it doesn't grow in Sal'thorin!
say:18:1421815015:1.source_cn: 可是，我十分确定，萨洛克兰并没有这样的植物生长！

choice_prompt:19:1421815015.text: I'm absolutely sure it doesn't grow in Sal'thorin!
choice_prompt:19:1421815015.source_cn: 可是，我十分确定，萨洛克兰并没有这样的植物生长！

say:20:1421815016:1.text: Let me take a look at the remaining dashroot powder!
say:20:1421815016:1.source_cn: 我想再看看剩余的疾根草粉末！

say:21:1421815017:1.text: This smell and texture... It's dyed nightshard ash!
say:21:1421815017:1.source_cn: 这种味道，这种质感……这是染过色的暗烬晶体灰烬！

say:22:1421815018:1.text: Nightshard is a type of crystal found in extremely dry volcanic regions, with strong water-absorbing properties...
say:22:1421815018:1.source_cn: 暗烬晶体生长在极为干燥的熔岩地区，吸水性极强……

say:23:1421815019:1.source_cn: 所以这里的巨蕈才会枯萎！

say:24:1421815020:1.source_cn: 这个奸商！我们去找他算账！

say:25:1421815021:1.text: We can do that later. Now, we should restore the jungle first.
say:25:1421815021:1.source_cn: 别急，当务之急是让这里恢复原样……

say:26:1421815022:1.text: Magister, what can we do to bring the jungle back to life?
say:26:1421815022:1.male: Magister, what can we do to bring the jungle back to life?
say:26:1421815022:1.female: Magister, what can we do to bring the jungle back to life?

choice_prompt:27:1421815022.text: Magister, what can we do to bring the jungle back to life?
choice_prompt:27:1421815022.source_cn: 魔法师<male>先生</male><female>小姐</female>，还有办法让这里恢复生机吗？
choice_prompt:27:1421815022.male: Magister, what can we do to bring the jungle back to life?
choice_prompt:27:1421815022.female: Magister, what can we do to bring the jungle back to life?

say:28:1421815023:1.text: Are you saying the growth potion can also revive withered plants?
say:28:1421815023:1.source_cn: 您的意思是，速生魔药除了能加速植物生长外，也具备让枯萎...
say:28:1421815023:1.male: Are you saying the growth potion can also revive withered plants?
say:28:1421815023:1.female: Are you saying the growth potion can also revive withered plants?

choice_prompt:29:1421815023.text: Are you saying the growth potion can also revive withered plants?
choice_prompt:29:1421815023.source_cn: 您的意思是，速生魔药除了能加速植物生长外，也具备让枯萎的植物复苏的能力？
choice_prompt:29:1421815023.male: Are you saying the growth potion can also revive withered plants?
choice_prompt:29:1421815023.female: Are you saying the growth potion can also revive withered plants?

say:30:1421815024:1.text: I can see why. The potion must be essential for mages who study herbalism...
say:30:1421815024:1.source_cn: 确实，那些研究草药学的魔法师养的植物少不了受到各种摧残……

say:31:1421815025:1.text: Anyway, dashroot is the key ingredient for the potion... Looks like we have to find it one way or another.
say:31:1421815025:1.source_cn: 想炼制速生魔药，疾根草是必不可少的……所以问题又回到找...

say:32:1421815026:1.text: I've never wanted to be a botanist this badly!
say:32:1421815026:1.source_cn: 我从来没有这么希望过自己是个植物学家！

say:33:1421815027:1.text: Ironhold Bay does have water and a warm climate, but it's a vast region...
say:33:1421815027:1.source_cn: 锻炉峡湾确实有水系丰沛的地方，气候也较为温暖，可那是很...

choice_prompt:34:1421815027.text: Ironhold Bay does have water and a warm climate, but it's a vast region...
choice_prompt:34:1421815027.source_cn: 锻炉峡湾确实有水系丰沛的地方，气候也较为温暖，可那是很大一片区域……

say:35:1421815028:1.text: I'll go with you! Hopefully, all the biology I've been cramming lately will come in handy!
say:35:1421815028:1.source_cn: 那我跟你一起去！希望我最近恶补的生物学知识能派上用场！

say:36:1421815029:1.text: Magister, can I tag along? Maybe I can help!
say:36:1421815029:1.male: Magister, can I tag along? Maybe I can help!
say:36:1421815029:1.female: Magister, can I tag along? Maybe I can help!

say:37:1421815030:1.text: I'm familiar with plants and can always find the right place for them to thrive. My talent could be useful on the surface!
say:37:1421815030:1.source_cn: 我很了解花草，总是能找到它们乐意安居的地方，说不定到了...

say:38:1421815031:1.text: People used to tell me the surface was a barren place filled with Hypofiends.
say:38:1421815031:1.source_cn: 以前别人总是告诉我，地表是魔物肆虐、寸草不生的地方。

say:39:1421815032:1.text: But this book here features so many beautiful plants that grow on the surface! I can't wait to see them!
say:39:1421815032:1.source_cn: 可那本书上地表上那些种类繁多的花草树木……好美！我好想...

choice_prompt:40:1421815032.text: But this book here features so many beautiful plants that grow on the surface! I can't wait to see them!
choice_prompt:40:1421815032.source_cn: 可那本书上地表上那些种类繁多的花草树木……好美！我好想亲眼去看看！

say:41:1421815033:1.text: Don't worry! <style="stress"><player_name></style> will soon find a way for the Essail to roam the surface safely!
say:41:1421815033:1.male: Don't worry! <style="stress"><player_name></style> will soon find a way for the Essail to roam the surface safely!
say:41:1421815033:1.female: Don't worry! <style="stress"><player_name></style> will soon find a way for the Essail to roam the surface safely!

say:42:1421815034:1.text: I'll wait for you here then! Let's hope that day comes soon!
say:42:1421815034:1.source_cn: 那我留在这里等你们，希望那一天能尽快到来！

say:43:1421815035:1.text: I'll stay with you! I have so many questions about Sal'thorin.
say:43:1421815035:1.source_cn: 我陪着你！刚好我有许多关于萨洛克兰的问题想问你呢！

choice:40:0:1.source_cn: 你身上的诅咒仍未解除

choice:40:1:2.source_cn: 现在的地表对你仍有危险

choice:29:0:1.text: In fact, we mages use it more for its revival effect.
choice:29:0:1.source_cn: 复苏功能对魔法师来说甚至更实用
choice:29:0:1.male: In fact, we mages use it more for its revival effect.
choice:29:0:1.female: In fact, we mages use it more for its revival effect.

choice:27:0:1.text: We need to make the real potion.
choice:27:0:1.male: We need to make the real potion.
choice:27:0:1.female: We need to make the real potion.

choice:19:0:1.source_cn: 卖魔药材料的商人有问题
